bootstrap.learned_estimator: average seeds 7 and 11 per scene before family averaging
bootstrap.intervals: 95% pointwise, unadjusted for multiple comparisons, conditional on the two trained seeds; do not quantify training-run variability

stress_interpretation: Susceptibility perturbation plus new independent noise draws. Within-condition method comparisons are paired. Across-condition effects are combined stress, not isolated material mismatch effects.
timing_interpretation: Stored batch-forward timing excludes feature generation for networks and is not end-to-end latency. No acceleration claim is made here.
scope: Static discrete weak point-scatterer support reconstruction, as registered.
